nativeLayout.name: torch-relocation
nativeLayout.condition: available control width < 360 points OR Dynamic Type accessibility size

nativeLayout.name: accessibility-zoom
nativeLayout.behavior: Active centered above two inactive anchors; rowHeight = max(44, scaled lineHeight + 12), lineHeight 20 relativeTo subheadline; intrinsic text width plus 4-point horizontal padding, minimum width 44; second row offset rowHeight + 8

nativeLayout.name: station-feedback
nativeLayout.condition: All text sizes and both capture modes
nativeLayout.behavior: Independent centered status above framing; minimum height 20 scaled relativeTo caption, gap 8; Table preserves invisible space and hides status from accessibility; fixed 48-point trailing action remains beside shutter

nativeLayout.name: capture-rhythm
nativeLayout.behavior: 24-point framing-to-shutter gap and bottom inset; maximum cluster width 420, horizontal inset 20; shutter row height 76, side slots 48

nativeComponents.name: Selected zoom
nativeComponents.snippet:
Text(active ? Self.label(currentZoom) : Self.label(CGFloat(anchor)))
    .font(.subheadline.weight(active ? .semibold : .medium)).monospacedDigit()
    .foregroundStyle(active ? Color.yellow : Color.white)
    .shadow(color: .black, radius: 0, x: 1)
    .shadow(color: .black, radius: 0, x: -1)
    .shadow(color: .black, radius: 0, y: 1)
    .shadow(color: .black, radius: 0, y: -1)
    .fixedSize().padding(.horizontal, 4)
    .frame(minWidth: 44, minHeight: rowHeight)
    .background { if active { Color.clear.captureControlSurface(in: Capsule()) } }

representationNotes: Native semantic colors have no fabricated tonal ramps.
SwiftUI materials, semantic text and native snippets are preserved as v2 extensions rather than HTML/CSS approximations.
No HTML/CSS rendering proof or optical acceptance is asserted.

narrative.overview:
Table and Station keep collectors inside the camera image. Independent controls float over the scene: the white shutter leads, selected magnification uses restrained system yellow, and local dark material supports secondary actions. The result is clean, fast and confident, consistent with PRODUCT.md's precision reference tool.

This record covers the implemented capture surfaces only. It does not establish a design system for Results, Library or Settings. The approved capture brief and surface contract supply the language; the SwiftUI implementation supplies the tokens. The latest human corrections supersede the earlier contrast-only verdict and its selected zoom backing. This record reflects current source; it does not assign a new finish-review verdict. Both modes now request the same automatic camera policy. Physical camera acceptance, VoiceOver focus continuity and Reduce Transparency verification remain separate outstanding checks.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous camera imagery between independent controls.
A centered shutter and active zoom axis, with stable secondary capture slots.
Native semantic text, SF Symbols and local dark system materials.
Truthful magnification and Station status, with restrained state motion.

rules.name: The Local Contrast Rule
rules.body: Back operational text with local contrast where camera detail can compete with it; preserve visible image between independent controls.

rules.name: The Applied Value Rule
rules.body: Pinch text follows the actual factor and unrounded family, capping rounded labels at 1.9× and 2.9× before the next family. During a preset move, the selected destination is presented directly; intermediate applied factors remain authoritative for camera safety and interruption.

dos: **Do** keep the camera image visible between independent capture controls.
**Do** use native semantic text and dark system material in capture components.
**Do** preserve the centered active zoom and shutter axis through family changes.
**Do** pair Station state text with its native symbol and keep capture recovery distinct from queue recovery.
donts: **Don't** restore the rejected zoom dropdown or an enclosing opaque lower control band.
**Don't** count through intermediate applied factors during a preset move or label magnification as a focal length or physical lens.
**Don't** treat sampled colors, fixture scenery or schematic storyboard fills as production palette tokens.
**Don't** infer physical camera quality or complete accessibility acceptance from simulator presentation.
